root_cause.proposer_deadline_and_output_limit: services/source_ingestion/hypothesis_compiler.py::client_proposer called client._dispatch_turn(..., timeout_seconds=_PROPOSE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) with hard-coded _PROPOSE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15.0 and no max_output_tokens instead of the governed HYPOTHESIS_CARD deadline (hypothesis_card_deadline_seconds(), 90 s default) and output-token limit
root_cause.ledger_metering: client_proposer and HypothesisCompiler bypassed ExtractionLedger, so proposer calls were neither reserved nor counted against the 400-call daily cap and recorded no ledger event or token usage; DistillationWorker._distill_one also returned ('failed', ...) on proposer_failed instead of EXTRACTION_RETRY_OUTCOME and did not apply the long extraction retry schedule or per-record attempt limits (3/day, 6/total)
root_cause.defect_reattempt: cards that failed under the old 15 s proposer deadline with hypothesis_compiler_failed: proposer_failed were not listed in FIXED_DEFECT_REATTEMPT_OUTCOMES and were not redriven by redrive_extraction_unavailable_dead_letters / reattempt_fixed_defect_records

decisions.acceptance_2_ledger_metering_and_retries: HypothesisCompiler shares ExtractionLedger with HypothesisExtractor (via DistillationWorker.bind_ledger or direct constructor/env wiring). Before every proposer model call (only for testable cards without missing idea datasets or cached CompilerStore outcome), HypothesisCompiler.compile reserves one call via ledger.reserve_attempt(source_id, digest) against the 400-call daily cap and the per-record limits (3/day -> attempts_deferred to next UTC day, 6/total -> closed skipped with l2_extraction_attempts_exhausted), records failure counters via ledger.note_call_failure (timeout_calls, billing_failed_calls, unavailable_calls), and records an event in ledger.events with its own outcome (compiled, support_added, not_expressible, needs_data, proposer_failed, budget_exhausted, attempts_deferred, attempts_exhausted) and provider token usage ({input_tokens, output_tokens}). Retries replay the cached card from ledger.get_card(source_id, digest) without re-paying the card call, and DistillationWorker treats proposer_failed as EXTRACTION_RETRY_OUTCOME on the long retry schedule
decisions.acceptance_3_reattempt_and_redrive: Added FixedDefectOutcome(code='compiler_proposer_15s_deadline_timeout', fix='L2-HYPOTHESIS-COMPILER-PROPOSER-DEADLINE-20261127', required_substrings=('proposer_failed',), prefix='hypothesis_compiler_failed:') to FIXED_DEFECT_REATTEMPT_OUTCOMES in services/source_ingestion/hypothesis_card.py. Cards still in retry_wait are retried in Phase 1 of run_pending; any that reached distillation_dead_letters (or skipped) with hypothesis_compiler_failed: proposer_failed are redriven/re-opened at most once in Phase 2 via redrive_extraction_unavailable_dead_letters / reattempt_fixed_defect_records (stamping defect_reattempted=1 and redrive_count=1)

residual_findings: In test_hypothesis_compiler_wiring.py, existing tests set PANTHEON_L2_EXTRACTION_BUDGET_PATH while production and hypothesis_card.py read PANTHEON_L2_EXTRACTION_LEDGER_PATH (BUDGET_PATH_ENV); DistillationWorker.bind_ledger shares the extractor's in-process ExtractionLedger instance with HypothesisCompiler so both paths still share one ledger even when the env variable name is omitted in unit tests

Card extraction and proposer compilation share the per-record attempt counter (3/day, 6/total keyed by (source_id, source_digest) in record_attempts); because a succeeded card is cached in ledger.cards and never re-paid, a record that needed 1 card call has up to 2 proposer calls on day 1 and 3 more on day 2 (5 proposer calls total) before l2_extraction_attempts_exhausted
